resources.string: Choose calendars for this app’s reminders. These choices are separate from calendar display filters and widgets. No calendars are selected automatically.
Other calendar apps’ alerts are independent and may cause duplicates. Manage their notifications separately; keep calendar sync enabled.
Saved reminder choices couldn’t be read. Nothing has been reset or disabled.
Loading calendars. Saved selections are kept.
Calendar access is needed to check the current calendars.
Current calendar information is unavailable. Saved selections are kept.
No current calendars are available. Saved selections are kept.
Hidden in the calendar provider; coverage may be incomplete.
Calendar sync is off. Recent changes may be missing.
Read access is not confirmed. This calendar cannot be newly selected.
This calendar differs from the saved selection. The saved identity is kept; the replacement is not enabled for alerts without your confirmation.
The saved calendar identity can’t be fully checked. It is kept, not replaced. Scheduling still requires a fresh identity check.

Only continue if you trust the calendar and account shown. This replaces the saved identity with the current information, which may be less complete, and clears only this calendar’s explicit defaults. It does not prove a stable provider identity.
Calendar information changed again while this confirmation was open. Cancel and review the new information.
Optional rules for reminders stored with provider-default values. These rules do not create or edit event reminders. Blank offsets and an unresolved method stay unresolved.
Leave blank for unresolved. Existing special offsets are preserved until you change them.
Use a nonnegative whole number of minutes, up to 2147483647, or leave blank. -1 is not an explicit offset.
At midnight on the event date
Minutes before the event date’s midnight
All-day offsets use the device time zone, independently of the calendar’s display zone.
Non-local — not delivered by this app
Saving changes local reminder settings only. It does not verify permissions, schedule success, or actual device delivery.
Reminder settings changed elsewhere. Your pending edits are kept, but can’t overwrite the newer choices. Reload to review them; reloading discards pending edits.
The save couldn’t be confirmed. Your pending choices are kept; review saved choices before trying again.
Calendar information is too large to review here. Saved identities and pending choices are kept; no new identity can be confirmed.
Saved locally. Actual reminder delivery has not been verified.
The current account identity is unavailable. This calendar cannot be newly selected.
